summary: Sandbach United earned a crucial 1-0 victory over Stafford Town in their opening match of the season, with Tatters capitalizing on a keeper's mistake to secure the win. The Bach bounced back from a midweek defeat at Foley Meir and had to weather some early pressure, with goalkeeper Hall making a fine save in the opening minutes, though the match was disrupted by injuries to both Hall and Mitch Nolan. It was a welcome return to the Sandbach ground for ex-players Sam Lynch and Callum Parker, who lined up for the visitors.
